name: Dynamic Breadcrumb
description: Overrides core breadcrumb item labels per entity type and bundle using token-based patterns.
project_description:
The Drupal's build-in Breadcrumb module is based on the entity's title to display the link's label on each item of the breadcrumb, Dynamic breadcrumb module gives the possibility to change this for each bundle of an entity type.

 The module uses Token API and Token UI module in order to allow user choose tokens easily for a better UX.

 Once the module is installed and enabled, you can access the settings forms from: Administration > Configuration > User interface > Dynamic breadcrumb (/admin/config/user-interface/dynamic-breadcrumb) .

 For more details, please read the README file.
